source.attribution: NeqSim master, SystemPrEos with the matching AttractiveTerm* - the upstream this library is a port of, run from validation/neqsim/FlashTp.java
source.notes: Mathias-Copeman for UMR-PRU. NeqSim's term 17 is constructed without fitted parameters, so it reduces to the base Soave form with the UMR quartic `m`; azoth reproduces that rather than reading a column.

derivation:
The driver was run for methane 0.6 / n-butane 0.4 at 330 K and 25 bar on SystemPrEos with `setAttractiveTerm(17)`. NeqSim printed:

  beta 0.8391262906616233
  k    [7.3949442690635125, 0.33457228732617333]
  x    [0.09424825128124303, 0.905751748718757]
  y    [0.6969605656814846, 0.3030394343185153]
  Zl   0.09304758084514327
  Zv   0.8700159474157213

azoth reproduces all six to the same residue the other cubic cases show.
